title: Chang-shan
capsule: The Kingdom of Changshan (常山) was one of the Eighteen Kingdoms Xiang Yu carved out of the fallen Qin empire in 206 BCE, awarded to the former Zhao chancellor Zhang Er with its capital at Xiangguo in modern Hebei. Zhang Er's regime collapsed almost immediately when his rival Chen Yu invaded in 205 BCE, restored the old Zhao king, and drove Zhang Er to defect to Liu Bang's Han court. By 203 BCE Changshan had ceased to exist as an independent fief, absorbed into the Zhao–Han sphere during the Chu–Han Contention.
